title: Kramers-Kronig Unification of Neutrino Decoherence and Vacuum Resonances
content: Standard treatments of neutrino decoherence introduce an energy-dependent damping rate Γ(E) while assuming the dispersive matter potential vanishes (∆V = 0). We prove from the axioms of relativistic quantum field theory that microcausality rigorously forbids this assumption. We de rive the exact Flavor-Space Kramers-Kronig relation and establish that any physical decoherence mechanism must be accompanied by a causal dispersive partner potential ∆Vcausal(E). This partner generates the Decoherence-Induced MSW (DIMS) effect, producing resonant flavor conversion in a vacuum, and leaves a low-energy “shadow” of high-scale physics via UV/IR mixing. Simulating DUNE, atmospheric, and IceCube data, we show that including the mandatory Kramers-Kronig partner tightens the 95% CL bound on the decoherence scale γ0 by a factor of ∼ 88. We pro pose a model-independent Causality Filter to distinguish genuine physical media from acausal phenomenological fits.
